tests: a read-only file stops the export part-way, and the IDE reports nothing
steps:
Do it in a scratch folder made for this, <S> below (for example C:\Scratch\readonly-test). File > Export Project empties <S>\export.
1. Unzip export-stops-at-readonly-file.zip into <S>, so that <S>\export-stops-at-readonly-file.twinproj exists.
2. In a Command Prompt: mkdir <S>\export, then make three files in it, a-first.txt, m-readonly.txt and z-last.txt (echo x> <S>\export\a-first.txt, and so on), and attrib +R <S>\export\m-readonly.txt.
3. Open the project in the twinBASIC IDE. Its Export Path is ${SourcePath}\export and Export Verbose is on (Project Settings, Export).
4. Choose File > Export Project.
5. See, as the last three lines of the DEBUG CONSOLE: [EXPORT]  DELETE FAILED: \\?\<S>\export\m-readonly.txt, [EXPORT]  ERROR: unable to clean the output folder and [EXPORT] export failed. No dialog opens. <S>\export holds m-readonly.txt and z-last.txt: a-first.txt, which sorts before the read-only file, is deleted, and nothing was exported.
6. Afterwards: attrib -R <S>\export\m-readonly.txt.
Re-measured on BETA 995 by `ide-test.bat --only export`.
